candidate_definition: high subgroup specificity, sufficient coverage, stable activation and low functional redundancy

H6a.design: semisynthetic planted rules based on real feature distributions

H6b.design: two new tabular datasets; train-validation selection; one test opening
H6b.primary_endpoint: candidate effect minus median matched-control effect
H6b.positive_criterion: 95% interval above minimum effect and positive mean on each dataset
